name: command-palette
title: CommandPalette
description: The searchable list of every action, on Base UI's Dialog and an inline Autocomplete: a search field over grouped commands with icons and shortcuts, filtered in the page by label and keywords, opened by a hotkey; no network.
usage: Use CommandPalette as the one place where every action of the app can be found and run from the keyboard, with its shortcut shown: DBee's Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P. Pass groups of commands ({ id, label, shortcut, keywords, icon, disabled, onSelect }), control open with open and onOpenChange (and a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" for pointer users), and give hotkeys ("Mod+K": Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere) to toggle it anywhere. The palette closes before onSelect runs, so a command may open a dialog. Keep the list in sync with the app's shortcuts; for a few actions behind a button use DropdownMenu; for picking a value in a form, Combobox.

props.name: groups
props.description: The commands in groups; a Command is { id, label, shortcut?, keywords?, icon?, disabled?, onSelect }.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a hotkey, Escape, a press outside or a command opens or closes it.

props.name: hotkeys
props.description: Shortcuts that toggle the palette anywhere in the page, such as "Mod+K"; Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's and the search field's accessible name (the title is visually hidden).

slots.name: viewport
slots.description: Dialog's layer at z.modal, the popup near the top; data-slot="command-palette-viewport".

slots.name: input
slots.description: role="combobox" search field in size.control.lg; data-slot="command-palette-input".

slots.name: list
slots.description: role="listbox" of groups, at most size.panel.sm tall, scrolling; data-slot="command-palette-list".

slots.name: empty
slots.description: The text shown when nothing matches; data-slot="command-palette-empty".

parts.name: CommandPaletteItem
parts.description: One command's row, role="option": icon, label and shortcut (<kbd>), DropdownMenu's item look; CommandPalette renders one per command.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: Dialog's scale and fade; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The first match is highlighted as the user types; arrows move the highlight: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A command that cannot run now: color.fg.disabled; it does not run.

accessibility: The palette is a modal role="dialog" named by a visually hidden title; focus goes to the search field (role="combobox") which controls a role="listbox" of role="option" commands in role="group"s named by their headings.

Typing filters by label, keywords and group and highlights the first match; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight (aria-activedescendant) while focus stays in the field; Enter runs the highlighted command; Escape closes and focus returns to where it was.
The hotkeys toggle the palette from anywhere; every command shows its own shortcut, so the palette also teaches them.
Disabled commands are shown, so the user learns they exist, but cannot run.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns Dialog's transitions off.
The palette takes the theme and density of the region where it is placed.
